newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 877 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 877 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 877 contracts compared with 1,827 overnight Tuesday.
There were 124 wheat, 255 corn, 275 soybean, 149 soymeal, four soyoil, four wheat calls, one corn put, 62 soybean calls and three soybean puts traded.
In overnight trade, wheat was 3/4 to two cents lower, corn was 1/4 cent lower to 1/2 cent higher and soybeans were two to 5-1/2 cents higher.
